## 3. Mathematical Foundations & Theoretical Proofs

### 3.1 Control Barrier Functions & Forward Invariance (Nagumo's Theorem)
For a control-affine non-linear dynamic system:
$$\dot{x} = f(x) + g(x)u, \quad x \in \mathcal{D} \subset \mathbb{R}^n, \quad u \in \mathcal{U} \subset \mathbb{R}^m$$
where $f$ and $g$ are locally Lipschitz continuous. Let the safe set $\mathcal{C}$ be defined as the super-level set of a continuously differentiable function $h: \mathcal{D} \to \mathbb{R}$:
$$\mathcal{C} = \{x \in \mathcal{D} \mid h(x) \ge 0\}, \quad \partial\mathcal{C} = \{x \in \mathcal{D} \mid h(x) = 0\}$$

By Nagumo's Theorem, the set $\mathcal{C}$ is forward invariant (if $x(0) \in \mathcal{C}$, then $x(t) \in \mathcal{C}$ for all $t \ge 0$) if and only if:
$$\sup_{u \in \mathcal{U}} \left[ L_f h(x) + L_g h(x) u + \alpha(h(x)) \right] \ge 0, \quad \forall x \in \mathcal{C}$$
where $L_f h(x) = \nabla h(x)^T f(x)$ and $L_g h(x) = \nabla h(x)^T g(x)$ are Lie derivatives, and $\alpha$ is an extended class $\mathcal{K}_\infty$ function.

### 3.2 Minimum-Norm CBF-QP Safety Filter
Given a nominal or unconstrained command $u_{\text{nom}}$ produced by an AI model, LLM agent, or human operator, the safe control input $u^*$ is computed via quadratic programming:
$$u^*(x) = \arg\min_{u \in \mathcal{U}} \frac{1}{2} \|u - u_{\text{nom}}\|_Q^2$$
$$\text{subject to: } L_f h_i(x) + L_g h_i(x) u \ge -\alpha_i(h_i(x)), \quad \forall i \in \{1, \dots, N_{\text{obs}}\}$$
$$u_{\min} \le u \le u_{\max}$$

### 3.3 High-Order Control Barrier Functions (HOCBF, Relative Degree $r=2$)
In automotive active suspension and second-order systems where the control input appears in the $r$-th time derivative ($r > 1$):
$$\psi_0(x) = h(x)$$
$$\psi_1(x) = \dot{\psi}_0(x) + \alpha_1(\psi_0(x)) = L_f h(x) + \alpha_1(h(x))$$
$$\psi_2(x, u) = \dot{\psi}_1(x) + \alpha_2(\psi_1(x)) = L_f^2 h(x) + L_g L_f h(x) u + \dot{\alpha}_1(h(x)) + \alpha_2(\psi_1(x)) \ge 0$$
This guarantees that relative-degree-2 constraints (such as suspension rattle space limits $|z_s - z_u| \le s_{\max}$) remain forward invariant.

### 3.4 AUTOSAR E2E Profile 1 CRC-8 Formulation
Data integrity on high-speed serial and CAN communication links is certified using AUTOSAR End-to-End (E2E) Profile 1:
- Generator polynomial: $G(x) = x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1$ ($0\text{x}1\text{D}$) over Galois Field $\text{GF}(2)$
- Initial value: $0\text{xFF}$
- XOR mask: $0\text{xFF}$
- Minimum Hamming distance: $d_{\min} \ge 4$ up to 2048 data bits, detecting all 1, 2, and 3-bit burst transmission errors.

6. **`antigravity-robotics-plugin`**
